## Before submitting

- Confirm the problem still occurs with the latest release.
- Use **Settings → Diagnostics** to collect relevant evidence.
- Remove monitor serial numbers, device-instance identifiers, user names and other personal information from logs and screenshots.
- For a security vulnerability, use [private vulnerability reporting](../../security/advisories/new) instead of this form.
